name: MACH frameset with integrated cockpit
claimed_frame_weight_basis: Maker claim for a painted frame; a retailer-weighed white size-M frame was 1,150 g

editorial.verdict: A low-cost aero race frameset with modern T47/UDH standards, 32 mm clearance and a stiff, direct ride, but its weighed frame is heavy and its fit, seatpost and mainland pricing need checking.
best_for: aero-focused road racing on a budget
riders who want a deep-head-tube aero frame with a matching KUNG cockpit
strengths: US$1,549 export price with an integrated cockpit
Five-size geometry with reach and stack
caveats: Retailer-weighed size-M white frame: 1,150 g, well above the 972 g painted claim
Only a 10 mm-offset seatpost; non-round bar-end plugs
No mainland price visible without JD login; export price excludes shipping and tax
Stiffness and ride evidence comes from the selling retailer, not an independent test

included: KUNG integrated aero cockpit (K-POWER or DA 5x5)
accessory package; confirm headset, axles and hardware
purchase_route: KUNG's JD flagship store (攻（KUNG）旗舰店) lists the MACH frameset with the DA5*5 integrated bar; its price needs a JD login. Panda Podium sells the exact frameset for export at US$1,399, or US$1,549 with an integrated cockpit.
